name: QBee
description: QBee develops quantum computing software for scientific domains including computational chemistry, genomics, and earth observation. Founded by quantum computer architecture professor Koen Bertels, the company translates classical algorithms into quantum-optimized formulations and has won international competitions for quantum climate-change solutions.

products.name: PISQ Quantum Algorithms
products.description: Protocol-Independent Software for Quantum approach applied to genome sequencing and satellite imaging

products.name: Quantum Simulator
products.description: Scalable quantum accelerator simulator for running quantum workloads

highlights: Won international quantum competition (35 teams) for climate change solutions
Multi-year contract for quantum space project

news.title: Belgian Startup QBee Bridging Quantum Computing & Humanity
news.excerpt: QBee, a quantum technology startup founded in 2020 by Koen Bertels, is based in Brasschaat and working on projects including quantum micro-architecture, quantum computing simulator, quantum high-level programming, quantum genomics, and quantum finance.
